headline: Repo rate raised by 25 bps to 6.75% (illustrative scenario)
body: Illustrative scenario for demonstration. The Monetary Policy Committee increases the policy repo rate by 25 basis points. External-benchmark-linked floating-rate loans typically reprice within one reset cycle; banks usually extend tenure rather than raise the EMI unless the borrower opts otherwise.

headline: Repo rate cut by 50 bps to 6.00% (illustrative scenario)
body: Illustrative scenario for demonstration. A 50 basis point cut lowers the external benchmark for repo-linked loans. Borrowers on floating rates see either a smaller EMI or a shorter remaining tenure at the next reset.

headline: Lenders revise MCLR upward by 10 bps (illustrative scenario)
body: Illustrative scenario for demonstration. MCLR-linked loans reset on their own schedule, usually every six or twelve months, so the change reaches borrowers with a lag.

headline: Retail inflation eases within the target band (illustrative scenario)
body: Illustrative scenario for demonstration. Softer food prices pull headline CPI back inside the 2–6% tolerance band, which tends to reduce pressure for further rate increases.

headline: Gold prices hold near record levels (illustrative scenario)
body: Illustrative scenario for demonstration. Elevated gold prices raise the marked-to-market value of physical gold and sovereign gold bond holdings; consider revaluing gold assets.

headline: Small savings rates unchanged for the quarter (illustrative scenario)
body: Illustrative scenario for demonstration. Rates on PPF, NSC and Sukanya Samriddhi are held for the next quarter.

headline: Housing sales steady in major metros (illustrative scenario)
body: Illustrative scenario for demonstration. Stable mortgage rates support residential demand across Bengaluru, Pune and Hyderabad.

headline: Banks trim fixed deposit rates on select tenures (illustrative scenario)
body: Illustrative scenario for demonstration. New deposits on one-to-two-year tenures earn slightly less; existing FDs keep their booked rate until maturity.
